name: Chromatic Null-Scattering Free-Flight Sampling
aliases: One-sample multiple importance sampling for chromatic media
RGB channel sampling for null scattering
definition: Handling RGB chromatic media by sampling a single color channel (R, G, or B) for distance sampling, while averaging the probability density functions (PDFs) across all channels to maintain unbiasedness. This is a form of multiple importance sampling called one-sample multiple importance sampling.
summary: Chromatic Null-Scattering Free-Flight Sampling reduces spectral path tracing variance by sampling a single color channel for distance while averaging PDFs across all channels to maintain unbiasedness.
